# Game UI Panels

> Wire game HUDs, menus, dialogs, and panels to real state and interactions.

## Primary instructions

- SKILL.md: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/game-ui-panels/blob/main/SKILL.md
- Installation: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/game-ui-panels/blob/main/docs/install.md
- Update: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/game-ui-panels/blob/main/docs/update.md

## Install

`npx skills add Fable-Forge/game-ui-panels`
